title: Forecasting Associations, Not Interventions: A Preregistered Causal Audit of Covariate-Aware Time Series Foundation Models
note: Single-author paper. Chronos-2, TiRex-2, TabPFN-TS, TimesFM-2.5 vs OLS on synthetic causal models and two physical systems. Reports models respond to covariates like observational regression (confounded); preregistered grid; no code link or test window on abstract page.

title: Same page: numbers
note: Abstract numbers: slopes 1.3-1.8x regression; OLS recovers 100% of effect difference vs 75% Chronos-2, 34% TiRex-2; 2-5x underreaction on physical systems; post-training cuts gap up to 83%, MASE cost +47% to +10% with prior replay. No load data.

title: amazon/chronos-2 model card
note: Apache-2.0. Natively supports past and known-future covariates. Page shows no commit date; latest dated note is 2026-06-05 (deployment guide).

title: Search for code or replication (found nothing)
note: Standard web search on the paper title found no code repository and no replication; only differently titled related work on counterfactual probing of TSFMs, not checked.
